verdict.rationale: Granola's API and MCP give programmatic read access to meeting notes, transcripts, and summaries, and docs mention building custom agents on top of that data (granola-docs-1, granola-docs-16, granola-docs-34, granola-docs-42). However, there's no evidence the API exposes the many interactive UI capabilities—Chat-driven actions like drafting/sending emails or Slack messages, calendar event creation, Recipes, templates, folder/sharing management—nor is there a public OpenAPI spec (probe shows 404s), suggesting the API surface is narrower than the UI. missing for 10: API/MCP support for write-actions (chat workflows, follow-up email/Slack drafting, calendar scheduling), template/recipe management via API, and a documented OpenAPI spec showing full UI parity.
